**Finding submitted: deviation (AUDIT).**

- No standalone audit clause exists; the operative analogue is § 11.3, where "IBM reserves the right to investigate potential violations of the representations and warranties in Subsection 11.2(b)."
- That right is unlimited in frequency, unannounced (the p0137 notice undertaking is best-efforts only and applies solely before IBM restricts access or removes Content), silent on business hours, independence/confidentiality of the investigator, cost allocation, and system access — which reaches our walk-away position.
- Redline (validated ok:true): one inserted paragraph after p0137 imposing once-per-12-months frequency, 30 days' prior written notice with an emergency carve-out, business-hours conduct, an independent auditor under confidentiality, IBM's cost unless a breach or >5% underpayment is found, and no access (including remote) to Customer systems, with cooperation via records instead. Fallback of 15 days' notice / 10% threshold flagged in the comment.
